answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1387 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the beacon. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the tundra queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. The hollow index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 336 account operation therefore ties up 5 million dollars of idle capital. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
